title: The whole-value tooltip walk reads a shadow Kind that is now two segments
goal: A scripted check that proves a shortened menu value is spelled out on hover fails part way through, because it still looks for a shadow Kind menu that became two buttons (Drop and Inner) earlier today. Point it at what the shadow row now shows so the check runs to the end again.
notes: Reproduced 2026-10-05 by the-tool-lens-text-style-and-component-menus-in: `Scripts/playtest-all.sh --no-build --only <list>` printed `menu-says-its-whole-value-walk 8s FAILED step 27 (expect): no tooltip called "Kind" in "Shadow" is in the panel; the ones that are: Shadow Style, Color, Twist, Reorder, Switch, Remove, Style, Color, Drop, Inner`. Step 27 is `{"do":"expect","tooltip":"Kind","in":"Shadow","present":true}`; commit b4c89240 (Two-way effect settings are a segmented control) moved Kind onto EffectChoiceRow, whose segments carry the tooltips. Likely fix: expect tooltip Drop or Inner in Shadow, or move the two-of-a-kind claim to a row that is still a dropdown (Position in Border).
acceptance: Its two-of-a-kind step still claims something about a row name that appears on more than one row

log.note: Reproduced: step 27 failed exactly as in notes. Replaced the Kind-in-Shadow claim with two claims on Style (the text's Style menu and the shadow's Style both carry the word, with different sentences): unnamed reads the text's sentence, in Shadow reads the shadow's. Walk ok at Next defaults (no flags), 28 steps, 1 real capture. Scripts/test.sh green (11399 tests). Walk-only fix, no audit (no feature changed).

menu-says-its-whole-value-walk passes again at Next defaults: its two-of-a-kind step now claims the word Style, worn by both the text and its shadow, and checks that naming the Shadow row picks the shadow's sentence. Commit f35eeee2; walk run green, Scripts/test.sh green.
